annotations.title: Search 16 government open-data portals for datasets

description: Government open data search across 16 national portals in one call: Korea (data.go.kr), Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, UK, Canada, the EU catalog (139,000+ datasets), Germany, Italy, Ireland, Switzerland, Netherlands, Israel and Chile. Query in any language; each match returns organization, update time and download URLs ready for opendata.table. Portals that did not answer are listed. Input: query; optional region, limit, portals. $0.10 per call. Returns: query, region, portals_searched[], portals_ok[], portals_failed[], total_matches{}, results[{portal, title, description, organization, landing_url, resources[{url, format}]...}], result_count, checked_at.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

portals.description: Specific portal ids instead of a region, e.g. ["data.go.kr", "data.bodik.jp"].

query.description: Words to search for, in any language (인구, 人口, rainfall, Bevölkerung).

region.description: Which portals to search. Default all (16 portals, concurrently).

name: hubvibe_opendata_search
title: Search 16 government open-data portals for datasets
